mapper.sql: FROM sr_english_vocabulary_word w LEFT JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_memory m ON m.account_id=#{accountId} AND m.word_id=w.id

sql.if: AND (w.word LIKE CONCAT('%',#{f.q},'%') OR w.translation LIKE CONCAT('%',#{f.q},'%'))
AND (m.memory_count > 0 OR m.first_rated_at IS NOT NULL)
AND COALESCE(m.memory_count,0)=0 AND m.first_rated_at IS NULL

if.test: f.mastery != null and f.mastery != 'ANY' and f.mastery != 'UNRATED'

sql.if: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item pi WHERE pi.account_id=#{accountId} AND pi.word_id=w.id)
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item pi WHERE pi.account_id=#{accountId} AND pi.word_id=w.id)

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_english_vocabulary_plan(account_id) VALUES(#{accountId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id=account_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan p WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT , (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(group_no),0) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId}) AS total_groups, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(BIT_COUNT(done_mask)),0) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId}) AS completed_ratings FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan p WHERE p.account_id=#{accountId}

SELECT word_id,group_no,sort_no, CASE WHEN (done_mask & 1)=0 THEN 'EN_TO_ZH' WHEN (done_mask & 2)=0 THEN 'ZH_TO_EN' ELSE 'AUDIO_TO_BOTH' END AS direction FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND done_mask!=7 ORDER BY group_no, CASE WHEN (done_mask & 1)=0 THEN 0 WHEN (done_mask & 2)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,sort_no LIMIT 1
SELECT word_id,sort_no,group_no,done_mask,word_json FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item SET done_mask=done_mask | #{bit},started_at=COALESCE(started_at,#{now}) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId}
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(group_no),0) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND started_at IS NOT NULL
SELECT MIN(sort_no) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND group_no > #{frozen}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item SET group_no=#{frozen}+1+FLOOR((sort_no-#{firstSort})/#{batchSize}) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND group_no > #{frozen}
mapper.select: SELECT w.id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY w.sort_order,w.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT w.id AS word_id,MD5(CONCAT_WS('|',w.id,w.theme_id,w.word,w.translation,COALESCE(w.scene_meaning,''),COALESCE(w.phonetic_us,''),COALESCE(w.phonetic_uk,''),COALESCE(w.inflections,''),COALESCE(w.examples,''),w.sort_order)) AS token WHERE w.id > #{after} ORDER BY w.id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_memory WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND (memory_count > 0 OR first_rated_at IS NOT NULL) AND word_id IN #{id}

SELECT w.id AS word_id,COALESCE(m.memory_count,0) AS memory_count,COALESCE(m.mastery_score,0) AS mastery_score, m.mastery_rank,m.first_rated_at,m.last_rated_at,m.last_reviewed_at,m.next_review_at, COALESCE(m.learning_status,'NEW') AS learning_status,cp.display_mode, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_vocabulary_plan_item pi WHERE pi.account_id=#{accountId} AND pi.word_id=w.id) AS in_plan
LEFT JOIN sr_english_vocabulary_card_preference cp ON cp.account_id=#{accountId} AND cp.word_id=w.id WHERE w.id IN #{id}
SELECT FROM sr_english_vocabulary_mode_memory WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id IN #{id} ORDER BY word_id,direction
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_english_vocabulary_memory(account_id,word_id,learning_status,first_learned_at) VALUES(#{accountId},#{wordId},'ACTIVE',#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id=account_id
mapper.select: SELECT word_id,memory_count,mastery_score,mastery_rank,first_rated_at,last_rated_at FROM sr_english_vocabulary_memory WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sr_english_vocabulary_mode_memory(account_id,word_id,direction,rating_count,ema_score,review_step,recent_good_count,last_rating,first_rated_at,last_rated_at,next_review_at,audio_verified) VALUES(#{accountId},#{mode.wordId},#{mode.direction},#{mode.ratingCount},#{mode.emaScore},#{mode.reviewStep},#{mode.recentGoodCount},#{mode.lastRating},#{mode.firstRatedAt},#{mode.lastRatedAt},#{mode.nextReviewAt},#{mode.audioVerified}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating_count=VALUES(rating_count),ema_score=VALUES(ema_score),review_step=VALUES(review_step),recent_good_count=VALUES(recent_good_count),last_rating=VALUES(last_rating), first_rated_at=VALUES(first_rated_at),last_rated_at=VALUES(last_rated_at),next_review_at=VALUES(next_review_at),audio_verified=VALUES(audio_verified)
INSERT INTO sr_english_vocabulary_rating_day(account_id,word_id,rating_day,direction) VALUES(#{accountId},#{wordId},#{day},#{direction}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE account_id=account_id
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT rating_day) AS total,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rating_day BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end} THEN rating_day END) AS recent FROM sr_english_vocabulary_rating_day WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_memory SET memory_count=memory_count+1,review_count=review_count+1,mastery_score=#{score},mastery_rank=#{rank}, first_rated_at=COALESCE(first_rated_at,#{now}),last_rated_at=#{now},last_rating=#{rating},last_reviewed_at=#{now},last_memory_at=#{now},learning_status='ACTIVE',version=version+1, next_review_at=(SELECT MIN(next_review_at) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_mode_memory WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId}) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId}
UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_mode_memory SET review_step=13,next_review_at=LEAST(next_review_at,#{cap}) WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND word_id=#{wordId} AND review_step=14
mapper.select: SELECT word_id,review_session_id,direction,rating,source,plan_revision,audio_played,old_step,new_step,old_score,new_score,review_number,scheduled_at,reviewed_at,interval_seconds,timing_status,result_json FROM sr_english_vocabulary_review_log WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND review_session_id=#{sessionId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE sr_english_vocabulary_review_log SET result_json=#{json} WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND review_session_id=#{sessionId} AND result_json IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS due_cards,COUNT(DISTINCT word_id) AS due_words, COALESCE(SUM(next_review_at < #{today}),0) AS overdue_cards,MIN(next_review_at) AS earliest_due_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sr_english_vocabulary_review_log WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND reviewed_at >= #{today} AND rating IS NOT NULL) AS completed_today FROM sr_english_vocabulary_mode_memory mm WHERE account_id=#{accountId} AND next_review_at <= #{now} AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sr_english_vocabulary_word w WHERE w.id=mm.word_id)
